lesson.0.text: Experience: My prediction that the energy level would remain at 8 after moving right was wrong because it decreased to 6. Lesson: The warehouse_robot consumes energy when moving.

lesson.1.text: Experience: My prediction that the energy level would be 3 after delivering was wrong because the robot has enough energy (4) to complete the delivery without depleting its battery further. Lesson: Ensure that the robot has sufficient energy for all actions it needs to perform.

lesson.2.text: Experience: My prediction that the energy level would be 3 after moving left was wrong because it decreased by only 1 unit instead of 2 units. Lesson: Ensure that actions correctly update all relevant state variables.

lesson.3.text: Experience: My prediction that the energy would be 1 after moving left was wrong because the robot's energy depleted completely during the previous actions. Lesson: Ensure sufficient energy before performing consecutive actions that might deplete it.

lesson.4.text: Experience: My prediction that the robot's position would change to 1 after moving right was wrong because it remained at position 0. Lesson: Ensure that actions do not affect the state if they cannot be performed due to current conditions.

lesson.5.text: Experience: My prediction that the energy level would be 1 after charging was wrong because it increased to 8. Lesson: Ensure accurate understanding of the effects of actions on state variables.
